annotations.title: Merchant agent terms: a dated record of a store's rules for AI agents

description: Merchant agent terms: a dated record of a store's rules for AI agents. Use when a shopping or browsing agent needs a signed, dated record of what a merchant site publishes for AI agents and bots: robots.txt rules for named AI agents and *, Content-Signal lines, agent and commerce discovery files, and the terms-of-use passages about automated access, with what changed since the last snapshot. Cost: 3 credits per call.

domain.description: The merchant's domain, such as shop.example. Records are keyed by the HTTPS origin of this host as typed, so send the same form (with or without www) each time to compare snapshots.

url.description: Any URL on the merchant site; its host is used and read over HTTPS. Send url or domain.

name: merchant_agent_terms
